answer: Adjacent-Seat Endorsement Curve: each new agent identity must be endorsed by two already-active agents positioned one tier apart on the trust river, and endorsement transfers a small score slice that decays with distance. Cloning forces attackers to route endorsements up a terrace of tiers, each hop costing a pearl of score plus latency. Because repeat endorsements of the same operator dilute that operator's own slice, marginal clones return negative EV.
